defect: stream FIFO behavior is hidden behind an unspecified storage primitive
rationale: The FIFO shell supplies depth and width parameters to a stub whose storage, pointer update, full/empty behavior, and output drive are absent. It is therefore impossible to decide whether data_o, valid_o, and ready_o obey the stream contract.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the FIFO interface and left the implementation as an explicit black-box storage dependency.

mutation.description: The FIFO state machine and drive behavior are intentionally omitted from the integration shell.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.note: Stub module has no body so output driving behaviour cannot be decided.
